title: Redesign resume components with brutalist styling
description:
Phase 4: Apply brutalist design to all resume-specific components.

WHY: Resume components need special treatment to maintain functionality while adopting brutalist style.

TASKS:
1. Update _sass/_resume.scss:
   - Section headers: Black boxes with white text
   - Page header: Bordered avatar, boxed name
   - Contact button: Thick borders, brutalist hover
   - Resume items: Heavy borders, structured layout
   - Icon links: Bordered containers with instant hover
   - Footer: Top border with brutalist styling
   - Print styles: Thinner borders but maintain aesthetic

CRITICAL COMPONENTS:
- .section-header h2: Black background, white text, 3px border
- .header-name: Black box, 5px border, large font
- .contact-button: 4px border, instant black-on-white hover
- .resume-item: 3px border, structured padding

PRINT CONSIDERATIONS:
- Reduce border widths to 1-2px for print
- Maintain high contrast for readability
- Preserve all content structure

FILES TO MODIFY:
- _sass/_resume.scss

DEPENDENCIES:
- resume-5r4 (variables)
- resume-ip2 (base styles)
- resume-l04 (layout system)

PARALLELIZATION: Must wait for all P1 tasks to complete

TIME ESTIMATE: 60 minutes

title: Set up brutalist foundation - Update variables and mixins
description:
Phase 1 of brutalist transformation: Establish the foundation variables and mixins.

WHY: Core design system elements must be defined first before any styling can be applied.

TASKS:
1. Update _sass/_variables.scss:
   - Replace color variables with pure black/white
   - Set monospace font stack (ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas)
   - Define border width scale (2px, 3px, 4px, 5px)
   - Create spacing scale for brutalist layout
   - Add transition disable variable

2. Update _sass/_mixins.scss:
   - Remove all transition-based mixins
   - Add brutalist border utility mixins
   - Create responsive breakpoint mixins (mobile, tablet, desktop)
   - Add print style mixins for brutalist design
   - Create hover effect mixins with instant state changes

FILES TO MODIFY:
- _sass/_variables.scss
- _sass/_mixins.scss

DEPENDENCIES:
- None (this is the foundation task)

TIME ESTIMATE: 30 minutes

title: Final validation and performance check
description:
Phase 7: Final validation and performance optimization.

WHY: Ensure the brutalist transformation is complete and performs well.

VALIDATION CHECKLIST:
□ All text uses monospace fonts
□ Pure black/white color scheme
□ Heavy borders on all elements
□ No rounded corners anywhere
□ No transitions or animations
□ Links work with hover states
□ Contact button functions
□ Social icons display correctly
□ Print styles work
□ Responsive on all devices
□ Cross-browser compatible

PERFORMANCE CHECKS:
1. CSS file size comparison
2. Load time testing
3. Render performance
4. Print performance

FINAL STEPS:
1. Compare with nulad.github.io design
2. Validate all content is accessible
3. Check SEO implications
4. Document any deviations

DEPENDENCIES:
- All P1 and P2 tasks complete

PARALLELIZATION: Final task, must run last

TIME ESTIMATE: 30 minutes

title: Test responsive design and print styles
description:
Phase 5: Comprehensive testing of responsive behavior and print functionality.

WHY: Brutalist design with thick borders needs careful testing across devices and print.

RESPONSIVE TESTING:
1. Mobile (≤768px):
   - Verify border scaling (2-3px)
   - Check font size scaling
   - Test touch targets
   - Validate vertical stacking

2. Tablet (769-1024px):
   - Test hybrid layouts
   - Verify border widths
   - Check responsive grid

3. Desktop (≥1025px):
   - Full brutalist borders (4-5px)
   - Two-column layouts
   - Hover states

PRINT TESTING:
1. Print preview validation:
   - Borders reduce to 1-2px
   - High contrast maintained
   - No broken layouts
   - All content visible

2. Print-specific features:
   - .no-print elements hidden
   - .print-only elements visible
   - Page breaks correct

TOOLS TO USE:
- Chrome DevTools device simulation
- Actual print to PDF
- Multiple device testing

DEPENDENCIES:
- All P1 tasks must be complete

PARALLELIZATION: Can run in parallel with resume-vr6

TIME ESTIMATE: 45 minutes

title: Implement brutalist base styles and typography
description:
Phase 2: Implement brutalist base styles that will apply globally.

WHY: Base styles define the fundamental appearance of all HTML elements.

TASKS:
1. Update _sass/_base.scss:
   - Disable all transitions universally (* { transition: none !important })
   - Redesign typography (h1-h6) with borders and black backgrounds
   - Style links with underline and black-on-white hover states
   - Create brutalist list styles with square bullets and left borders
   - Style code blocks with heavy borders
   - Redesign form elements with thick borders

KEY DESIGN DECISIONS:
- Headers get black backgrounds with white text
- Links underline with 2px thickness
- All borders use pure black (#000000)
- No rounded corners anywhere
- Instant hover effects (no transitions)

FILES TO MODIFY:
- _sass/_base.scss

DEPENDENCIES:
- resume-5r4 (must have variables and mixins ready)

PARALLELIZATION: Can be worked on immediately after resume-5r4 starts

TIME ESTIMATE: 45 minutes

title: Transform layout system for brutalist design
description:
Phase 3: Transform the layout system to support brutalist design patterns.

WHY: Layout containers need heavy borders and rigid spacing to match brutalist aesthetic.

TASKS:
1. Update _sass/_layout.scss:
   - Redesign .wrapper with thick borders (4px)
   - Create .content-section with borders and padding
   - Implement responsive grid with brutalist spacing
   - Add utility classes for text alignment and floats
   - Create responsive utilities (hide/show on mobile)
   - Design page header and footer with heavy borders

RESPONSIVE STRATEGY:
- Mobile: Thinner borders (2-3px) to save space
- Desktop: Full brutalist borders (4-5px)
- Maintain geometric spacing throughout

FILES TO MODIFY:
- _sass/_layout.scss

DEPENDENCIES:
- resume-5r4 (variables for borders/spacing)
- resume-ip2 (base styles for consistency)

PARALLELIZATION: Can start once resume-5r4 is complete, doesn't need to wait for resume-ip2

TIME ESTIMATE: 40 minutes

title: Validate cross-browser compatibility
description:
Phase 6: Validate cross-browser compatibility for brutalist design.

WHY: Monospace fonts and CSS borders can render differently across browsers.

BROWSER TESTING MATRIX:
1. Chrome/Chromium:
   - Monospace font rendering
   - Border thickness accuracy
   - Hover state performance

2. Firefox:
   - Font stack fallback
   - Border rendering
   - Print functionality

3. Safari:
   - ui-monospace support
   - Border rendering
   - Mobile Safari behavior

4. Edge:
   - Compatibility with Chrome
   - Print preview

KEY AREAS TO TEST:
- Font stack falls back correctly
- Border widths render consistently
- Hover states work instantly
- Print styles apply correctly
- Responsive breakpoints trigger

POTENTIAL ISSUES & SOLUTIONS:
- Font rendering: Add fallbacks
- Border variations: Use explicit values
- Transition removal: Ensure !important
- Print styles: Browser-specific prefixes

TESTING APPROACH:
- BrowserStack or similar
- Local browser testing
- Print to PDF from each browser

DEPENDENCIES:
- All P1 tasks must be complete

PARALLELIZATION: Can run in parallel with resume-d7l

TIME ESTIMATE: 60 minutes
